svg.text: Input eFuses block reverse current. A5 and B5 feed only the mux and their own authorized output branches.
OVLO nominal 5.376 V. UVLO nominal 4.188 V rising. ITIMER open for minimum delay.
OVLO nominal 5.376 V. UVLO nominal 4.188 V rising. ITIMER open for minimum delay.
Prioritize valid A5. B5 sustains SYS5 if A5 falls. Feed SYS5 exclusively to M1 P1.23 (5V/VSYS).
U1_RAW and U2_RAW are upstream pins.
A5 and B5 remain independent protected rails.
SYS5 is local power. It never feeds either receptacle
3V3_PER is an independently enabled local rail.
Electrical design review / Named nets are joined across sheets / x = intentional NC
